slice.leaf: rmcp-v3.1.4 task lifecycle authorization-context propagation under Streamable HTTP
slice.finding: At exact rmcp-v3.1.4, ServerHandler::get_task(GetTaskParams, RequestContext<RoleServer>), update_task(UpdateTaskParams, RequestContext<RoleServer>), and cancel_task(CancelTaskParams, RequestContext<RoleServer>) all receive RequestContext. Service<RoleServer>::handle_request validates the Tasks capability and passes that same context into each task method. Streamable HTTP injects http::request::Parts into the inbound MCP request Extensions before dispatch, including the evidenced negotiated-stateless, ordinary stateless, initialization/session, and general request paths. The generic service loop swaps request Extensions into RequestContext.extensions. Therefore a server-authenticated Principal previously inserted by trusted HTTP middleware into Parts.extensions can be recovered with one fail-closed nested lookup helper from RequestContext in call_tool and all three handler-exposed task lifecycle methods on these Streamable HTTP paths.
slice.task_result_endpoint_note: No separate ServerHandler get_task_result method exists in the exact handler surface inspected; tasks/get is get_task and returns GetTaskResult. The handler-exposed task update path is update_task; cancellation is cancel_task.
fail_closed_conditions: Principal type does not satisfy the HTTP Extensions insertion/retrieval bounds
transport path is not one of the evidenced Streamable HTTP paths
